searchText: In the context of [BPO](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7892#execution-layer-configuration), how is EL config going to look like for future forks? For example, will there be "amsterdam" under "blobSchedule"? Or would there be just another "bpoX"?

excerpts.author: milos88
excerpts.content:
In the context of [BPO](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7892#execution-layer-configuration), how is EL config going to look like for future forks?
For example, will there be "amsterdam" under "blobSchedule"? Or would there be just another "bpoX"?
